description:
Play Guildless Commons.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
